result.summary: The page is a food delivery app home screen that appears mostly well-designed and functional. A few minor layout issues exist with content truncation and inconsistent styling.

issues.description: The 'Trattoria Piccol...' restaurant card in the 'Fastest near you' row is cut off at the right edge, truncating both the name and delivery details.
issues.suggestion: Ensure horizontal carousel items snap or display with proper padding so partially visible cards clearly indicate scrollability without truncating important text mid-word.

issues.description: The favorite (heart) icons are inconsistent between cards: the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card has a white heart outline, while the pizza card below has a dark circular background with a white heart. This inconsistency may look unintentional.
issues.suggestion: Standardize the heart icon styling and background treatment across all restaurant cards for visual consistency.

issues.description: The bottom pizza restaurant card is cut off at the bottom of the viewport, showing only the image with a '-20%' badge but no restaurant name or details.
issues.suggestion: This is expected scroll behavior, but ensure the card teaser height reveals enough to entice scrolling without appearing broken.
